Render a standalone metabolomics analysis report

Source: R/render_metabolomics.R
render_metabolomics.Rd

Runs the full direct-injection metabolomics workflow (preprocessing, batch correction views, PCA, OPLS-DA / PLS-DA, fold change, t-test / ANOVA, volcano plot, ROC) on one dataset and writes a single self-contained HTML report (all tables and figures embedded) plus an .rds of the results to a results folder next to the input file. The workflow lives in the package, so projects never hold their own copy.

Usage

render_metabolomics(
  features,
  metadata = NULL,
  features_sheet = NULL,
  metadata_sheet = NULL,
  metadata_cols = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  output_dir = NULL,
  sample_id_col = "Sample",
  group_col = "Group",
  batch_col = "Batch",
  injection_col = "InjectionSequence",
  qc_types = c("QC", "SQC", "EQC"),
  normalize_method = "median",
  norm_factor_col = NULL,
  normalize_qc_method = "none",
  control_group = NULL,
  ...,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  timestamp = FALSE,
  quiet = TRUE
)

Arguments

features

Path to the features file (or the combined file), or a data frame.

metadata

Path to the metadata file, or a data frame. Omit when metadata_sheet is in the features workbook, or for a combined table.

features_sheet, metadata_sheet

Sheet names (workbooks only).

metadata_cols

Extra metadata column names for a combined table.

name

Report name; default the features file name.

output_dir

Folder that will contain results/. Default: the folder of the features file.

sample_id_col, group_col, batch_col, injection_col

Metadata column names.

qc_types

Group labels identifying QC samples.

normalize_method

Normalization method (e.g. "median", "sum", "pqn_global"); see dimsprepr::run_DIpreprocess.

norm_factor_col

Numeric metadata column with per-sample normalization values (e.g. specific gravity for urine). When given, it overrides normalize_method.

normalize_qc_method

How QC samples are normalized when norm_factor_col is used (QC rows usually have no value): "median", "mean" or "none" (default). Ignored without norm_factor_col.

control_group

Reference group for ROC (two-group designs).

...

Per-function argument lists, see above.

overwrite

If FALSE (default) an existing report is never replaced: a timestamp (_YYYYmmdd-HHMMSS) is appended to the new file names. TRUE replaces the existing report and results.

timestamp

If TRUE, always append a timestamp to the file names.

quiet

Set FALSE to see Quarto's progress output.

Value

Invisibly, the path of the HTML report.

Data layout

Samples are rows and features are columns in features; metadata has one row per sample. Supply either

  • two files (features, metadata), or one workbook with two sheets (features_sheet, metadata_sheet), or

  • one table holding metadata and features together (give only features); all non-numeric columns plus sample_id_col, group_col, batch_col, injection_col and metadata_cols are treated as metadata, the rest as features.

Supported formats: .csv, .tsv/.txt, .xlsx/.xls. A data frame can also be given instead of a path (then set output_dir). Features may carry a sample ID column, or be in the same row order as metadata; a features table with samples as columns is transposed automatically.

Overriding function arguments

Settings of the underlying functions are passed through ... as one named list per function, so the same argument name in different functions is never ambiguous:


render_metabolomics("serum.xlsx", features_sheet = "features",
  metadata_sheet = "metadata",
  run_foldchange = list(arrange = c("Control", "Case"), up = 2),
  plot_volcano   = list(pval = 0.01),
  run_DIpreprocess = list(missing_threshold = 0.3))

Valid names: run_DIpreprocess, plot_beforeafter, plot_dist_beforeafter, run_pca, run_pls, plot_score (PCA and PLS plots), plot_score.pca and plot_score.pls (only that plot; override plot_score), run_foldchange, run_diff, get_volcanodata, plot_volcano, plot_meanmap, run_auc. Argument names are checked against the function, and a supplied value replaces the workflow's default (including NULL). Data inputs (x) cannot be overridden.
